record.label: External CRX0 common-base remainder theorem
record.summary: Blocked until the sole reset/compiler reopen condition is proved. It must prove a common PSD base and a uniform source-domain remainder for connected K3-K5 conversion, including [11111], Q24/base tails, conditioning, and depth-16 propagation. This criterion is deliberately carrier-independent and contains no carrier read or integrated carrier-cost requirement.
record.terminal_criterion: Provide a target-free common-base theorem, source-domain certificate, uniform reset remainder through fifth order, exact small-n dense parity, and permutation/PSD invariants. Carrier construction and <=9935 integrated cost belong only to B2B3C, preventing a circular gate.
